strings: m_c is experiencing a psychotic episode.
m_c is completely convinced that every cat in the Clan has it out for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, despite any evidence to the contrary.
m_c insists to r_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} been chosen by StarClan to herald the end of the world - a terrifying prospect, but completely untrue.
